description: Compute standard financial ratios from a trial balance and report any missing inputs. When a trial balance or account summary needs standard ratios. Do not choose this when account names must be mapped from a chart of accounts. Example requests: Compute the financial ratios from this trial balance. | What are my margins and current ratio? | Give me a ratio report from these figures.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

trial_balance.description: The customer's trial_balance.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. One 'account=value' per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_financial_ratio_report
title: Financial ratio report
